box.highlights: Ward Melville 35, Whitman 21: Griffin Kramer rushed for 216 yards on 18 carries, Dan Brausch rushed for 90 yards and two touchdowns and Ethan Burgos rushed for 80 yards and two touchdowns to lead Ward Melville (1-0) in Suffolk I. Ward Melville scored 21 unanswered points and rushed for over 400 yards. Jayden Taylor threw 212 yards and three touchdowns for Whitman (0-1).

Floyd 31, Ward Melville 21
Caden Lesiewicz had two interceptions, kicked a 36 yard field goal, and had a rushing touchdown to propel Floyd (2-0) to a pivotal 31-21 victory in Division I. Jaden Montalvo rushed 16 times for 193 yards and two scores for the Colonials. Ward Melville is 1-1.

Ward Melville 34, Central Islip 0: Brody Morgan rushed for an 84-yard touchdown on the first play from scrimmage for Ward Melville (2-1) against visiting Central Islip. Dan Brausch carried four times for 90 yards, including a 65-yard touchdown and Ethan Burgos scored on a 36-yard run. Norman Bergamaschi and Mike Cartisano each added a rushing touchdown. Tony Gorsky and Jake Ventimiglia each had five tackles in Ward Melville's first shutout of the season. Central Islip is 0-3.

Griffin Kramer totaled 11 tackles, two sacks and returned an interception 37 yards for a touchdown to lead Ward Melville to a 29-7 win at Sachem North in Suffolk I football Saturday night. CJ Ward had 11 tackles, including two for a loss as Ward Melville (3-1) held Sachem North to 21 rushing yards and 145 passing yards. Ward added 121 rushing yards on 15 carries and Ethan Burgos rushed for 107 yards and two touchdowns on 18 carries. Dan Brausch added a 10-yard rushing score and an interception. Andrew Eaton caught a 77-yard touchdown pass from Anthony Vino for Sachem North (3-1).

Ward Melville 15, Lindenhurst 14: Ethan Burgos rushed for a 5-yard touchdown and completed the go-ahead two-point pass to Brody Morgan in the second quarter for visiting Ward Melville in Suffolk I. Earlier in the second quarter, Morgan caught a 13-yard touchdown pass from Burgos as Ward Melville (4-1) erased a 14-0 first-quarter deficit. Matthew Durnin caught a 13-yard touchdown pass from Christian Capogna and Gio Tarte rushed for a 3-yard score for Lindenhurst (2-3).

Ward Melville 28, Connetquot 17: Brody Morgan caught four passes for 112 yards and three touchdowns to lead Ward Melville (5-1) in Suffolk I. Ethan Burgos had two passing touchdowns and a rushing touchdown, and Sebastian Jolley added 84 receiving yards. Dan Brausch had an interception, a pass break-up and the game-sealing tackle. Nick Pepitone threw two touchdown passes for Connetquot (3-3).

Ward Melville 35, Longwood 21: Griffin Kramer rushed for 95 yards and two touchdowns on 13 carries and added 11 tackles, a tackle for loss, a sack and a forced fumble to lead Ward Melville (6-1) in Suffolk I. Ethan Burgos rushed for a touchdown and connected with Brody Morgan for two passing touchdowns. Caleib Corbett rushed for two touchdowns and threw a touchdown pass to Ryan Mandaro for Longwood (4-3).

AJ Vurchio rushed for 78 yards on 10 carries and scored the winning 2-yard touchdown with 1:17 left in host Sachem East's 32-27 win over Ward Melville in Suffolk Division I football on Friday.   Vurchio completed 14 of 18 passes for 269 yards and three scores. Mikey Reilly caught seven passes for 175 yards and touchdowns of 60, 44 and 25 yards and Justin Westerlind rushed for 112 yards and a TD on 18 carries for Sachem East (5-3). Ethan Burgos scored four rushing touchdowns for Ward Melville (6-2).

Ward Melville 14, Lindenhurst 10: Ethan Burgos had 14 carries for 92 yards and the winning 16-yard touchdown with 10 minutes remaining in host No. 3 Ward Melville's 14-10 win over No. 6 Lindenhurst in the Suffolk I quarterfinals. Burgos also threw a 13-yard TD to Sebastian Jolley in the first quarter. Brody Morgan caught five passes for 74 yards and Griffin Kramer rushed for 60 yards on 12 carries. 
Christian Aquino caught a 27-yard touchdown pass from Christian Capogna in the first quarter and Ben Chodon kicked a 22-yard field goal in the second quarter to give Lindenhurst a 10-7 halftime lead. 
Ward Melville (7-2) will visit No. 2 Sachem North in the semifinals on Friday. Lindenhurst finished 4-5.

Sachem North 27, Ward Melville 21: Lucas Singleton scored the winning 6-yard touchdown with 2:13 remaining to lead host No. 2 Sachem North over No. 3 Ward Melville in the Suffolk Division I football semifinals Friday night. Singleton had 22 carries for 123 yards, and two touchdowns, including a 79-yard score on the first play of the second half to give Sachem North a 21-14 lead.  
Dan Brausch rushed for a tying 2-yard TD early in the fourth quarter for Ward Melville. Ethan Burgos rushed for two touchdowns as the Patriots finished 7-3. 
Singleton added four receptions for 39 yards as Anthony Vino completed 10 of 14 passes for 138 yards and two touchdowns for Sachem North (8-2). Shane Reilly caught a 36-yard TD and Brayden Tappin caught a 40-yard score. 
Christopher Lombardo had nine tackles, Nasir Altes had eight tackles and Cole Munster had seven tackles and a sack. Vino recorded two interceptions and David Santiago and Kristian Hagelstein each had one interception. 
Sachem North will face the winner of No. 1 Floyd/No. 4 Longwood in the Suffolk I final at 7:30 p.m. on Friday at Stony Brook University.
